# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.8.0 — initial listing

- Added the `yes` plugin from [yuya-takeyama/agent-plugins](https://github.com/yuya-takeyama/agent-plugins) (`plugins/yes`, commit `debc4fb`) with the `design`, `explain`, `slides`, `quiz`, `video`, `zundamon-video`, and `course` skills, helper scripts, and the `bin/yes-speak` wrapper.
- No MCP server is bundled.
- Logo: the publisher's GitHub avatar.
